QuestInfo.name: Rendered Speechless
QuestInfo.0: #p1052121# convinced you to take an #bacting class#k. What kind of lesson is in store for you? Talk to #p1052121# who is standing in front of the Hair Salon in #bHenesys Market#k.
QuestInfo.1: Today's lesson is to learn an expression of speechlessness. To do so, you'll need to give Dr. #b#p1032104##k in #b#m101000000##k a serious shock... What could you say to shock Dr. #p1032104#? Think about it.
QuestInfo.2: You have learned the Speechless expression.

0.0: Hey, #h0#. You seem more Charming every time I see you. With a few more acting lessons, you'll be a real star! Shall we continue?

yes.0: Now for class number 3: The speechless expression. When common people are faced with uncommon situations, this is the face they make. Do you know Dr. #b#p1032104##k in #b#m101000000##k? She should be the perfect model for this expression.
yes.1: But first, you must figure out how to truly shock Dr. #p1032104#... Think about that. You know that #bshe's married and has kids#k... I'm sure you'll come up with something.

no.0: This isn't too hard an assignment, is it? You've been doing so well...

npc.0: Did you talk to Dr. #b#p1032104##k yet? She's in #b#m101000000##k.
